species.name: Dishwight

dex.text: A boggart that has moved into a kitchen dresser, and is responsible for every missing spoon. Its eyes are the two best plates.
dex.fact: A boggart is a household spirit of northern English folklore, blamed for sour milk, missing things and bumps in the night.

species.real: A Welsh dresser has open shelves built to show off the household's best plates, so a boggart has a ready-made hiding place and an audience.

species.name: Dresserwight

dex.text: A grand old dresser, hung with cups, with three eyes and a drawer that opens by itself. It rattles when it is cross and tinkles when it is not.
dex.fact: Boggarts are said to turn nasty if you name them or thank them, so the sensible householder leaves out a little something and says nothing.

species.real: Dressers were a main piece of kitchen furniture in farmhouses across Wales and northern England, and the best china sat on show.
